content: For unstable ADB connections to rooted Magisk Android devices, the reusable workflow is: first run a lightweight connectivity probe; if ADB remains unreachable, prioritize implementing immediately effective host-side multi-channel optimizations first, then prepare phone-side configurations for later deployment once ADB is stable, rather than repeatedly attempting unstable ADB read/write operations. Use fixed WiFi retry instead of random retries to improve ADB connection reliability.
